{{Quote|Com-scan has detected an energy field protecting an area of the sixth planet of the Hoth system. The field is strong enough to deflect any bombardment.|General [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]|<ref name="ESB" />}}
The '''DSS-02 shield generator''' was a defensive unit manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] early on in the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|Their primary target will be the power generators.|General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:Echo_Base_Shield_Generator_TCG.png|thumb|left|250px|The Echo Base shield generator on Hoth]]
The DSS-02 [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] was produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="EGWT" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used a generator to protect a [[Jade Moon supply base|supply hub]] on the [[Jade Moon]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] destroyed it to [[Battle of the Jade Moon|raid]] the hub. The Empire also used one to protect [[Prison/Legends|prisons]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. The Rebels were able to [[Rescue on Kessel|raid]] the prisons after the generator was disabled. The [[Weapons Research Facility]] on [[Fest/Legends|Fest]] was also destroyed by Rogue Squadron after its DSS-2 generator was destroyed.<ref name="RS I" />

One such generator was used by the Rebel Alliance to protect a portion of the ice-planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="ESB" /> This generator was powered by the base's main [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]], which were stolen from a derelict [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class battlecruiser]].

The shield was strong enough to withstand bombardment from an [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] and a flotilla of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="ESB" /> It was largely because of this as well as Admiral Ozzel's tactical blunder that the Empire was forced to land on the planet and do a [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|ground battle]] against the Rebels.

In addition, because of the shield generator's strategic importance to the Rebels, the area surrounding it was also heavily fortified with troops, turrets, troop centers, mech factories, heavy weapons factories, and others.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Expandsect}}
The DSS-02 shield generator first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. The advanced blaster upgrade may be found in the remains of the Rebel shield generator in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''.

Besides its appearance in the "Battlefield Hoth" mission of ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', the DSS-02 shield generator, or at least a similar shield generator in appearance, appeared in the mission "Defenders of Ralltiir" that was created by Ralltiir scientists sympathetic to the Rebel Alliance, which also acted as the only thing preventing the Imperials from capturing them immediately. According to the audio commentary, they reused the design for the DSS-02 shield generator from ''Rogue Leader'' for the mission in ''Rebel Strike''.
